heading: Birthday Site
html: From late April to mid May of 2025 I designed and created a website to convince my family to get me a Mac Mini. I was inspired by Beno Grids and Nev Flynn's Dev Site. I made my site on an old all-in-one computer. My site featured a four wide gride I used to showcase reasons I wanted my Mac Mini. Each box was a very basic div: rounded corners and a black border. To adapt to smaller screens, I added basic CSS responive web design (RWD) to shrink boxes down and cut the gride width. This was my first time using RWD and it shows. Much of the shrinking is messy and breaks some parts of the site.

heading: Isaac The Carpentopod
html: Isaac The Carpentopod is a walking robot that uses Giliam de Carpentier's Carpentopod Linkage. Isaac's body is fully 3D printed in PLA, his brain is an Arduinio mega paired with an L298N dual motor driver that powers both of Isaac's Gearbox DC Motors. Isaac was designed in OnShape using the ratios Giliam de Carpentier used in his Walking Table. These rations were generated by Giliam using software that eveloved thousands of leg generations until it found an ideal linkage. Giliam was inspried by Jansen's linkage, a similar linkage designed by kinetic sculptor Theo Jansen for his Strandbeest. Isaac was built for the Hackclub program Macondo. For previous projects, Hackclub provided me with funding and an amazing community. You can see Isaac on Hackclub here.
